versions.short: The resolution encourages everyone in the United States to find out their LDL-C (low density lipoprotein cholesterol) number. It designates September 2026 as National Cholesterol Education Month and September 30, 2026, as LDL-C Awareness Day. It also recognizes the urgent need to screen for and treat elevated LDL-C in order to reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease, heart attacks, and strokes.
